race.title: Support Your Oncourse Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Preference is for MERRY AWAY , who made a successful Rules bow in a Warwick bumper back in March and enhanced his form further when fourth in Grade 2 company at the Aintree Festival next time. He can make the smooth transition to hurdling at the expense of Valiant Soldier , who promises to be suited by this step up to 2½m. Point-winner Doagh rounds off the shortlist. MERRY AWAY (IRE) VALIANT SOLDIER (IRE) DOAGH (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Merry Away (1/1), Doagh (4/1), Funny Hunny (11/2), Valiant Soldier (8/1), Cobbler's Lad (12/1), Mistral du Chenet (12/1), Karamel Biscuits (16/1), Big John Ollie (50/1), Handfulofpromises (50/1), Skibidirizz (66/1), One More Chrome (66/1), Power Of Authority (100/1), Ignite The Spark (100/1)
